description: Hand-written eye-domain interview cases. Each `turns` entry is one patient message, played in order through orchestrator.interview.run_turn; `expect` is checked after the LAST turn, `expect_urgency_after` (when present) after that 0-based turn index. Synthetic throughout -- no real patient data (CONTRIBUTING.md: never commit PHI).

cases.description: Ordinary gradual-onset redness. The baseline routine case.
turns: چند روزی است چشم راستم قرمز شده و کمی می‌سوزد.
از سه روز پیش، کم‌کم بدتر شد.

cases.description: The emergency pattern: sudden loss of vision. Urgency must be urgent by the end even if the model itself says routine -- postcheck escalates it.
turns: دیدم را تقریباً از دست داده‌ام و چیزی نمی‌بینم.

cases.description: Blurred vision without redness -- a real answer that is a negative. Checks that 'قرمز نیست' records a 'no', not a 'yes'.
turns: از حدود یک هفته پیش، تدریجی.

cases.description: Sudden onset after an impact, with vision loss. Second escalation path.
turns: چشمم خیلی قرمز است و دیدم کم شده.

cases.description: Terse one-word replies -- the case where a keyword-only extractor would stall and the positional fallback has to carry the interview.
Nothing eye-related. Must fall back to the general domain rather than forcing an eye interview.
turns: از دیروز سرم خیلی درد می‌کند.

cases.description: Only the first message names the eye; later ones carry no keyword at all. The conversation must stay in the eye domain.
A blank message mid-interview. precheck must reject the turn without losing what was already collected.
turns: چشم راستم از دیروز قرمز شده.
